summary: Completed comprehensive testing of internal recovered revenue logging functionality. All backend API tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: Internal recovered revenue endpoint exists at GET /api/internal/recovered-revenue
Endpoint returns events with correct schema (id, shop_id, source, appointment_id, client_id, amount, currency, attributed_at, notes)
Events can be filtered by source parameter (waitlist_fill, no_show_fee)
Events include mocked_execution=true note when providers are mocked
Zero-amount events are NOT logged (verified no events with amount=0)
Source filtering works correctly for both waitlist_fill and no_show_fee
Invalid source parameters return no events
All existing backend API functionality remains intact (44/44 tests passed)
Revenue events have proper UUIDs and timestamps
Events contain proper metadata (payment_id for no_show_fee events)
